code.simulation: 06_simulation of the site's first simulator (72 h building temperature) with the options point_heights and noise_model
code.note: As the first simulator (site_simulator.py), with the point heights (city or uniform) and the noise model (constant or amplitude) as settings, the motion model per building only, and layers centred on the Cabauw sensors at 10, 20, 40 and 80 m (cab: 3.2, 16.8, 23.2, 56.8, 103.2 m and the top).

simulated.label: KNMI-built air
simulated.building_temperature: 72 h memory of the KNMI 344 hourly air temperature

radiosonde.label: Balloon soundings 2025
radiosonde.building_temperature: 72 h memory of the KNMI 344 hourly air temperature
radiosonde.note: The reconstructed 2025 soundings have 453 launches, sometimes two on one day; the estimation reads one epoch per day (d_YYYYMMDD columns), so the launch nearest 06 UTC of each day is kept: 361 passes, and the simulation is run on those.

cabauw.label: Cabauw tower 2025
cabauw.building_temperature: 72 h memory of the KNMI 344 hourly air temperature
cabauw.note: The tower export has all seven levels on 124 mornings; after 2025-04-30 only 8 isolated August days are left, which would act as lever points for the trend terms after the three-month gap, so the estimation stops at the end of the continuous record.
